title: ModulePackageService
responsibility: Plan pinned dependency declarations without installing packages.

inputs.name: ModulePackageService.plan.root
inputs.description: Directory string joined with package.json to read the manifest. The implementation does not require or check that it is absolute.

inputs.name: ModulePackageService.plan.name
inputs.description: Registry package specifier with an optional lowercase scope and an exact numeric major.minor.patch version, optionally followed by a lowercase prerelease suffix. Package segments must start with a lowercase letter or digit and may otherwise contain lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores, or hyphens; version ranges, tags, uppercase letters, and build metadata do not match.

outputs.name: ModulePackageService.plan
outputs.description: Resolves to a planned write with path set to package.json and contents holding the serialized manifest. The contents use tab indentation and end with a newline; the requested package version is assigned in dependencies.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when the package specifier does not match the accepted registry-name and exact-version pattern, or when the selected existing dependency has a different version. A package.json read failure also rejects with the filesystem error.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown by JSON.parse when the contents read from package.json are not valid JSON.
